title: COP Accounting Reservation Event
description: Event type for resource reservation and release. Reservations prevent concurrent double-spending by temporarily holding budget capacity.

action.description: Action being performed. 'reserve' creates a hold, 'release' cancels it, 'commit' converts to transaction, 'expire' is system-triggered expiration.

quantity.description: Quantity being reserved, released, or committed.

budget_reference.description: Budget against which this reservation is held.

reserved_for_account.description: Account that will receive the reserved amount upon commitment.

purpose.description: Purpose for which the reservation is made.

max_extension.description: ISO-8601 duration for maximum extension (e.g., 'PT1H' for 1 hour).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for this reservation event.

related_transaction_id.description: For 'commit' actions, reference to the transaction that consumes this reservation.
